lines.1: 「Yoshimi really does have everything going for her.」
lines.2: 「I ran into her in the shopping district today too.」
lines.3: At the bookstore, she set down her shopping bag and got absorbed in a cookbook, so I grabbed the bag.
lines.4: 「S-Samesuga, why? Why did you take my bag?」
lines.5: 「Give it back! Come on, give it baaack!」
lines.9: I wonder what she is doing at this hour.
